raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?f
  where all
    match
      relation "be at"
      role subject ?f
      role object "the Constanța depot"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be a forklift"
      role subject ?f
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have service visits"
      role subject ?f
      role object ?n
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?n above 2
  during "since January"
